title: [finding] security-plugin.ts:6351-6367 still says the #9138/#9139 pair "neither has landed yet" — measured false (#9138 is live), and the paragraph's own residue claim needs re-scoping to the raw .parse() path
body:
Handed over by the #13699 census run (read-only dispatch, fenced from filing) and filed by the dispatching seat (`session_01PBjwYLS6BciTQW3c9xQiD2`). Dedup: targeted search returned unrelated closed cards only (live channel).

Measured (full evidence: the os-dev-report on #13699): `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts:6351-6367` states 「neither has landed yet」 and 「#9138 … is dispatchable now but not yet merged」 about the master-detail required pair — **false on current main**: #9138 is CLOSED and `ObjectSchema.create()` measurably forces `required: true` under `controlled_by_parent` (omitted → forced true; explicit false → refused). The note's own last line invites the correction (「Re-check this paragraph before trusting it」).

Correction, not deletion: the residue the paragraph guards IS still reachable via the raw `.parse()` path (measured: `safeParse` accepts CBP + `required: false`) — the rewrite should state that narrowed truth. Prose-truth class (#13621 family). Refs: #9138 (closed) · #9139 (the ruled v18 escalation carrier) · #13699 (census, closed duplicate).
